scope: Local client/project management, shared metadata, browser mobile preview, visual builder, generic runtime and illustrative quotations only; no production authentication, native packaging/PWA installation, server tenancy, payment, AI integration or VPS validation.

results.name: Fresh workspace starts empty with no fabricated clients, projects or activity
Project publications retain earlier configuration and quote snapshots, including legacy versions
Project archive/reactivation and deletion preserve the client, other projects, data and shared assets
Sample registry: thirteen distinct modules include the selectable Mobile app capability
Starters: blank is default, categories use valid distinct modules, legacy projects remain compatible
Model: client configurations are independent and templates are not mutated
Model: publish creates an immutable-by-copy snapshot and requires an app
Model: entities and fields reject duplicates and invalid references/types
Shared entity deletion: field consent and invalid references fail atomically; app data, prices and published versions are preserved
Shared entity deletion: remove the last entity, preserve empty state across reload, then add a replacement
Mobile app: category starter, editable placeholder prices and reusable record/rule model remain project-specific
Migration: existing client IDs, branding, shared fields and published snapshots survive
Client directory migration: repeatable linking preserves complete project data, including records and published quotes
Client profiles: create without projects, validate atomic edits, keep project names and branding separate
Multiple projects per client: app edits, records, quotes and publications are independent
Client deletion: explicit related-project confirmation, atomic rejection and preservation of unrelated clients and shared templates
Client deletion: standalone clients and the last client can be removed without reseeding
Pricing: additive minor-unit totals, removal, discounts and invalid values
Pricing: catalog edits and draft edits do not change existing or published quotes
App runtime: required/type validation, create rules, notes, edits and client isolation
Fresh browser shows empty management overview and one creation flow with optional frameworks, without sample clients
Management overview preserves saved legacy clients and projects during upgrade
App library requires explicit project selection and adds apps to the chosen project
Client dialogs keep header/actions clickable across short, narrow and mobile viewports; fields scroll without losing values or hiding validation
Client directory creates standalone profiles, edits details, safely renders notes, searches contacts and persists reloads
New project defaults to blank and explains category starter module/price selections
App selection changes only the selected client draft and live preview
Brand edits persist per client without changing another demo client
Entity/field creation updates the client form preview
Saving a demo version reports success; View saved version opens the snapshot and distinguishes later draft edits across reloads
New project links to an existing client and starts from a pristine framework without other project customizations
One client has multiple independent projects; project search, metadata editing and reopening update only the selected project
App category filters and client search work
Customer storefront and standalone platform website previews open and navigate
Uploaded logo renders on the storefront and remains client-specific
Create custom app and design a typed required field without code or prompts
Visual pages render safely; forms save/edit records and on-create rules execute
Reusable custom app brings schema/rules to another client without copying records
Project totals react to selection, overrides and discounts; quotes publish and survive reload independently
Management overview, client profile/dialog, project hub/editor, library and app designer fit a 390px mobile viewport
Empty directory survives reload and nested client creation resumes project setup without losing inputs
Client list provides direct editing and deletion; cancelling keeps data, standalone deletion persists and preserves the active unrelated project

Deleting every client and project leaves a usable empty directory after reload without restoring demo seeds
Project management supports daily app use, retained version previews, archive/reactivate, pending-change filters and independent project deletion on desktop/mobile
Shared data explains entity/field/record, confirms deletion, survives storage failure and reload, preserves publications and recovers from no entities
Mobile app can be selected from a starter or catalog, edited visually, previewed in a phone layout and used for persistent local records
